tasks.title: Register/prepare CCS customer and representative reporting
tasks.why: From filing through completion of Phase 1, the transitional SPSAV must submit customer/user and representative information to CCS.
actions: Confirm CCS registration/access prerequisites and reporting layout.
Map KYC source fields to CCS requirements.
Define onboarding, change and closure reporting events.
Test extraction, validation and submission process.
Assign operational owner and backup.
tasks.definitionOfDone: CCS process is production-ready before filing and can operate from the protocol date.

tasks.title: Implement COSIF-compatible accounting / virtual-asset account mapping
tasks.regulatoryBasis: Res. 520 transition accounting obligations and current COSIF framework
tasks.why: 5710/5711 and prudential reporting depend on accounting and custody data being classified consistently.
actions: Map Kinetic ledger accounts and crypto positions to applicable COSIF accounts/control accounts.
Define valuation sources and reporting cut-off.
Document customer asset, proprietary asset and staking accounting treatment.
Reconcile accounting, custody and operational subledgers.
Have external accounting specialist review.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Signed accounting mapping supports regulatory reporting and produces reproducible reconciled balances.

tasks.title: Build 5711 daily custody reporting
tasks.why: 5711 captures daily information relating to custody/accounting positions during the Phase 1 transition period.
actions: Obtain current 5711 technical layout/XSD and validation rules.
Map source fields from customer ledger, custody platform and accounting.
Build automated extraction/transformation and validation.
Define business-day cut-off, exception handling and approval.
Run parallel test days and reconcile results.
tasks.definitionOfDone: 5711 can be generated, validated, reconciled and approved every required day from filing onward.

tasks.title: Build 5710 monthly proof-of-reserves and staking reporting
tasks.why: Transition reporting includes verifiable monthly proof of reserves and, where applicable, customer assets allocated to staking.
actions: Obtain current 5710 layout and technical validations.
Define proof-of-reserves methodology and data sources.
Determine whether Kinetic/Rules staking falls in scope and map fields if applicable.
Build monthly extraction and approval workflow.
Test reconciliation to 5711/custody balances.
tasks.definitionOfDone: 5710 can be produced from reconciled source data and approved within the required reporting timetable.

tasks.title: BCB systems access: Unicad, Sisorf, STA and responsible users
tasks.regulatoryBasis: IN 704 and IN 713 operational submission requirements
tasks.why: A perfect report that nobody can submit is merely an attractive data file.
actions: Identify required BCB systems and credentials for application/reporting.
Register responsible directors/employees and contact details as required.
Establish primary and backup users, MFA/certificates and access controls.
Perform access tests and document support/escalation contacts.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Primary and backup users can access every required BCB submission channel before the first filing/reporting date.

tasks.title: Regulatory reporting calendar, controls and management certification
tasks.why: The transition creates recurring reporting obligations immediately after filing, so ownership must be operational before the protocol is sent.
actions: Create reporting calendar including daily, monthly, event-driven and BCB-request items.
Define maker/checker/approver controls and evidence retention.
Create breach/escalation procedure for late or rejected submissions.
Design monthly management certification of completeness and accuracy.
tasks.definitionOfDone: A controlled reporting calendar operates from filing date with named backups and retained submission evidence.
